upload_diff_to_codereview: upload a diff from git svn or mercurial to the codereview app using upload.py
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using the --rev option with git svn or mercurial
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP upload requests
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate with Google ClientLogin to obtain auth tokens and cookies for the code review server
run_shell_command: execute a shell command and capture stdout output and return code using RunShellWithReturnCode
